The validated change set is in `.niyam/changeset.json`. It lists each change with its exact source quote, page and clause.
The source document is registered in `sources/index.yaml` as `gr-202407031335114330` (date 2024-07-03).

Do this:
1. Read CLAUDE.md (the rulebook rules), the change set, and the files of the affected scheme(s): mh.ladki_bahin.
2. Apply every change in the change set, following CLAUDE.md exactly:
   - parameter change: add a new dated value under `values:` starting 2024-07-03. Never edit or delete older values.
   - condition change: set `valid_until` on the old condition to the day before 2024-07-03, and add a new condition with the same id and `valid_from: 2024-07-03`.
   - condition removed: only set `valid_until` to the day before 2024-07-03.
   - every new value or condition gets `source` / `metadata.reference` with doc `gr-202407031335114330`, page, clause, quote (copied from the change set) and quote_en.
   - if a change needs a new person field, add it to `schema/person.yaml` with a safe default that keeps existing results unchanged.
3. Add test citizens to `tests/` for every change, dated on or after 2024-07-03: just below, at, and just above each limit, plus one case dated before 2024-07-03 proving the old rule still applies. Each case cites `GR 202407031335114330 p.<page> clause <clause>` in `source`.
4. Add an entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md (English, Hindi, Marathi) linking to the document.
5. Run `python -m niyam_rulebook test` and fix problems until it prints `0 failed` with no PROBLEM lines.
6. Do not run git. Do not edit files outside schemes/, parameters/, tests/, sources/, glossary/, schema/ and CHANGELOG.md.

Finish with a short summary of what you changed and the final test result.

6	## Baseline: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (GR dated 28 June 2024)

- हिंदी: 3 जुलाई 2024 से 65 वर्ष (पहले 60) तक की महिलाएं आवेदन कर सकती हैं। अविवाहित महिलाएं अब पात्र हैं, लेकिन प्रति परिवार केवल एक अविवाहित महिला। संविदा, बाह्य यंत्रणा या स्वयंसेवी कर्मचारी वाले परिवार अब अपात्र नहीं हैं (नियमित कर्मचारी और पेंशनभोगी अब भी अपात्र)। जो महिला अन्य सरकारी योजनाओं से हर महीने 1,500 रुपये या अधिक पाती है वह पात्र नहीं (पहले केवल 1,500 रुपये से अधिक पर)। पांच एकड़ कृषि भूमि की सीमा हटा दी गई है।
- मराठी: ३ जुलै २०२४ पासून ६५ वर्षांपर्यंतच्या (पूर्वी ६०) महिला अर्ज करू शकतात. अविवाहित महिला आता पात्र आहेत, परंतु प्रति कुटुंब केवळ एक अविवाहित महिला. कंत्राटी, बाह्य यंत्रणेद्वारे कार्यरत किंवा स्वयंसेवी कर्मचारी असलेली कुटुंबे आता अपात्र नाहीत (नियमित कर्मचारी आणि निवृत्तीवेतनधारक अजूनही अपात्र). इतर शासकीय योजनांतून दरमहा १,५०० रुपये किंवा अधिक लाभ घेणारी महिला पात्र नाही (पूर्वी केवळ १,५०० पेक्षा जास्त असल्यास). पाच एकर शेतजमिनीची मर्यादा वगळली आहे.

content.text:
The rulebook now matches the 2024-07-03 GR. `python -m niyam_rulebook test` prints `47 passed, 0 failed`, with no PROBLEM lines. I didn't run git, and I only edited files in the allowed folders.

**Parameters** (new dated values from 2024-07-03, older values untouched):
- `age_max` goes from 60 to 65.
- `eligible_marital_statuses` gains `unmarried`.
- `disqualifying_govt_jobs` goes from `[regular, contract, pensioner]` to `[regular, pensioner]`.

**Conditions in `schemes/mh/ladki_bahin.yaml`:**
- `other_scheme_limit` now stops at 2024-07-02. A new version from 2024-07-03 uses `<` instead of `<=`, so receiving exactly Rs 1,500 from another scheme now disqualifies.
- `farm_land_limit` now stops at 2024-07-02. I added no replacement, so the five-acre limit is gone.
- I added a new condition, `unmarried_one_per_family`. It rules out an unmarried woman when `other_unmarried_beneficiary_in_family` is true.
- `schema/person.yaml` already had that field, so I changed nothing there.

**Tests** (22 new cases in `tests/mh/ladki_bahin.yaml`): each change has cases just below, at, and just above its limit, dated 2024-07-03. Each change also has one case dated 2024-07-02 showing the old rule still applies. All cite `GR 202407031335114330 p.2 clause <clause>`. The 2024-07-02 cases cite the old GR, since they test the old rule.

**Changelog:** I added an entry at the top of `CHANGELOG.md` in English, Hindi and Marathi, linking to the GR.

The change set has two open questions. I did not model either, as they affect no rule I could safely change:
- **Contract staff and the Rs 2.50 lakh cap:** I couldn't tell whether the cap applies to the employee's own income or the family's. Contract staff no longer disqualify, and the existing family-income test still applies. The tests confirm family income above Rs 2.5 lakh still makes the family ineligible.
- **Ration-card exemption:** I treated the yellow/orange ration card exemption as a documents change and left the income ceiling alone.
